name: Upleaf
meaning: a page lifting up, like the logo
label: In use elsewhere
found: No study or education product found. A posture-walking app, “Upleaf: Posture Walks” (Health & Fitness), is on the App Store, and a web agency uses upleaf.com. upleaf.app does not resolve.

name: Termwise
label: Used by a school app
found: An app named Termwise is on Google Play: school-management software for Nigerian schools (termwise.org, very few downloads). Not on the App Store in the US or Thailand. termwise.com is for sale; termwise.app is an unrelated browser extension.

name: Semstra
label: One letter from taken apps
found: Nothing found under this exact spelling (App Store US and Thailand, Google Play, semstra.com / .app / .co do not resolve). But Semestra, one letter longer and said the same way, is two Education apps on the App Store in Thailand and one on Google Play, all semester planners.

name: Semestra
